about.title: Modern storage solution built around your needs
text: At Allen Genoa Self Storage, we make it easy to store the things that matter. Our focus is simple: secure storage units, affordable options, and a smooth, stress-free experience from start to finish.
Whether you are organizing your home, moving, or storing business inventory, we provide a safe, clean and convenient place for your belongings.
Allen Genoa Self Storage isn't just a storage facility. It's a place built to give you peace of mind, modern security and easy access to your space whenever you need it.
We are at 2525 Allen Genoa Rd A, just south of the Pasadena Little Theatre on Allen-Genoa Road and a short drive from Space Center Houston, a convenient spot for residents, students and businesses.
Our team includes bilingual staff who assist customers in both English and Spanish, and we strive to answer all inquiries within 24 hours.

faqs.q: How do I reserve a storage unit?
faqs.a: Select the unit size you want and book online. If you have any questions about the units, please feel free to call us, we're always happy to help.

faqs.q: Can I reserve a storage unit in advance?
faqs.a: Yes. You can reserve a storage unit ahead of your move-in date. You do not have to pay for the unit until the day you move in.

faqs.q: How much are storage units near me in Pasadena?
faqs.a: Our storage units are competitively priced for the Pasadena area. Our current monthly rates are listed on this site, from $47.00 for an 8.5x5 interior unit, and every unit comes with 50% off your first month.

Self storage is the kind of storage that you can access regularly by yourself. Generally people use it when they have extra items they want to store outside their home to make additional space and/or when they are moving. Our facility is accessible via a secure personal keycode, so you are free to pop in to your storage unit and grab your things without a reservation in advance.

faqs.q: Do you have bilingual staff available?
faqs.a: Yes. Our facility has bilingual staff who can assist both English and Spanish speaking customers. Se habla español. If you prefer to communicate in Spanish, we are happy to help.

faqs.q: Is Allen Genoa Self Storage facility temperature controlled?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer climate-controlled storage units in Pasadena, TX.

faqs.q: Are there storage units with elevator access?
faqs.a: All of our storage units are ground-level access. No elevators or stairs are needed to reach your unit.
